headline: HuyenBao v11.47 — SVG biểu đồ donut + bar, home tab no-scroll, More info popup
summary: CHARTS + NO-SCROLL. (1) REAL SVG CHARTS: donut chart for asset allocation (color-coded segments with center count) + bar chart for income breakdown (horizontal bars with labels + values). Both are inline SVG — no external deps. (2) HOME TAB NO-SCROLL: removed guide, world news, ecosystem, achievements, timeline, life log from the home tab body. All that content is now in a 'More' popup with 5 sections. Home tab body is now just: health alerts + tutorial hint + quick action buttons (gigs, travel, more) + AI note. The dashboard (PinZone) with charts is the main view — everything fits without scrolling. (3) COMPACT DASHBOARD: 3-column layout in PinZone — donut chart (assets) | bar chart (income) | quick info (sleep + job + rent). Removed redundant left-column bars (health/spirit/XP already in top stat pills).
features: SVG DONUT CHART: asset allocation with color-coded segments + center count
SVG BAR CHART: income breakdown with horizontal bars + labels + values
HOME TAB NO-SCROLL: removed guide/news/eco/ach/timeline/log from body
MORE INFO POPUP: 5-section popup (Guide/News/Achievements/Timeline/Log) via 'More' button
COMPACT DASHBOARD: 3-column (donut | bars | info) replaces old 2-column (identity+bars | sleep+strip+rows)
REMOVED redundant left-column health/spirit/XP bars (already in top stat pills)
